description: This Java class defines a LoRaWAN provider implementation specific to Proximus within an Eclipse Hono adapter. It provides methods to retrieve provider name, path prefix, and to extract device ID and payload from incoming JSON messages.

classes.name: ProximusProvider
classes.description: A Spring Component implementing the LoraProvider interface for Proximus-specific LoRaWAN message handling.

methods.name: getProviderName
methods.description: Returns the name identifier of the provider, 'proximus'.

methods.name: pathPrefix
methods.description: Provides the URL path prefix associated with this provider, '/proximus'.

methods.name: extractDeviceId
methods.description: Extracts the device identifier (DevEUI) from the provided JSON message.

methods.name: extractPayload
methods.description: Extracts the payload string from the provided JSON message.
